notablePrerequisites: Animar has at least five +1/+1 counters on it.
description:
Cast Aethersnipe by paying {U}.
Radagast and Animar triggers.
Resolve the Radagast trigger, creating a 3/3 Beast creature token.
Resolve the Animar trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
When Aethersnipe enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning itself from the battlefield to your hand.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Beast token, adding {U}.
Repeat.
